title: Check whether a sign-in page needs signing in

guidance: Open a sign-in or application entry address in a new tab and report, once the page settled, what it asks of the visitor: sign-in-required (the sign-in monitor sees a sign-in wall, which wallType names, or the page shows a login and password form beside its content, with no wallType), signed-in (no wall and a signed-in account shows), blocked (a human check, bot check or site refusal before any sign-in) or unknown. A page whose sign-in form opens from a control (a header Sign in button) is unknown with signInEntries: sign in on the same checkId with method set to the entry that opens the form. Returns the settled origin and path only, the session, a checkId, and the pageContextId of the opened tab: read it with dsagent.page.observe and close it with dsagent.page.close when done. Fills and submits nothing. At most 20 checks a minute per caller (RATE_LIMITED, wait a minute). For signed-out checks use sessionGroup new with a sessionName, never sign the person's own session out.

inputSchema.description: The address to check and the browser session to open it in.

url.description: The sign-in or entry address: http or https, with no user name or password in it.

sessionGroup.description: default (the person's own session; the default), new (a fresh isolated session named sessionName) or previous (the named session sessionName opened before).

sessionName.description: With new or previous: the session's name, lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

outputSchema.description: What the settled page asks of the visitor, where it settled, and the opened tab.

status.description: sign-in-required, signed-in, blocked, or unknown when no wall shows and no signed-in account either (also while the page is still loading: see loading).

wallType.description: The sign-in monitor's wall type, with sign-in-required and blocked.

page.description: Where the page settled, without its query or fragment.

session.description: The browser session the page opened in.

mode.description: default (the person's own session) or named.

checkId.description: Opaque id of this check, for a later sign-in on the same page.

pageContextId.description: The opened tab; absent when the check no longer stands for it.

loading.description: The page was still loading when the check ended, so status is unknown: check again later, or call the sign-in on this checkId, which waits for the page first. The tab stays yours to observe or close.

signInEntries.description: With unknown: the page shows no sign-in form yet, and these controls may open one (a header Sign in button, a sign-in link); their labels are page text. Sign in on this checkId with method set to the candidateId of the one that opens it: the click is verified, and nothing is typed until a login-and-password form shows.

items.description: One control: candidateId, label, kind (tab, link, button, other), selected.
